verdict.rationale: monday.com's integrations directory lists 850+ integrations. It explicitly names native Slack integration among its communication tools and GitHub/GitLab pull-request linking to items, which together cover the core of connecting common engineering tools natively. missing for 10: explicit evidence of a Google Drive integration (only Gmail and Google Calendar are named), detail on how deep the Slack and GitHub integrations go, independent or hands-on corroboration.
